# Tooling Requirements Checklist: Mutation testing across every app and lib

**Purpose**: Requirements quality for the runner, floors, ratchet and CI of the mutation runs
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Reviewed under `/speckit-auto` (depth: standard, audience: PR reviewer); each `[x]` names the spec text that satisfies it, and the gaps it found were fixed in spec.md first.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the exact set of projects that get a mutation run listed, with the excluded ones named? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Edge Cases] — 8 listed; `data-access`, `web-e2e` excluded.
- [x] CHK002 Is what gets mutated (source vs specs vs generated code) specified per project? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, US1 scenario 1]
- [x] CHK003 Is the behaviour for a project with tests but no mutation config defined? [Gap → fixed, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Are the two root commands and their project selection (all vs affected vs `main`) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "a few points below" the measured score quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009 → fixed: 5 points, rounded down, floor ≥ 0]
- [x] CHK006 Is "affected" defined (changed projects only, or with dependants)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Clarifications Q3]
- [x] CHK007 Is the runtime of each project's tests during a mutation run tied to an existing definition rather than restated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Clarifications Q1]
- [x] CHK008 Is what counts toward the score stated, including mutants that are not tested? [Gap → fixed, Spec §Assumptions (static mutants)]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do the no-tests rule (FR-004) and the floor rule (FR-009) agree on a project with no spec files? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, FR-009 — both say floor 0]
- [x] CHK010 Does the story's list of six projects reconcile with FR-001's eight? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions; context.md Contradictions — resolved by the Build brief's scope rule]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 Can each success criterion be checked without reading the implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-003]
- [x] CHK012 Is the ratchet's acceptance stated as both a refusal (lower) and an allowance (raise)? [Measurability, Spec §US4]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK013 Are failure outputs (below floor, time-out) required to name the project? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, US3 scenarios 2–3]
- [x] CHK014 Is the behaviour defined when the database the tests need is down? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Is an undefined score (nothing to mutate) addressed? [Gap → fixed, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional & Dependencies

- [x] CHK016 Is the CI time limit's source stated, given no number exists in any source? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions; plan Technical Context — set from measured runs]
- [x] CHK017 Is the owner's open question (scheduled full run) kept out of scope explicitly? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions; context.md Open Decisions]
- [x] CHK018 Are generated working files and reports required to stay out of git? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
